scope: Finite scenario and finite numerical-control envelopes only; no posterior, confidence coverage, independent holdout, blind discovery, formal p-value, or absence theorem.
training_footprint: |z|<=20arcsec; centers|z|<=10; prior full-cube source fit already unblinded.
relative_training_gates: 1.10/1.25/1.50 times nominal weighted RMS; these are sensitivity strata, not adequacy criteria.

numerical.method: Maximum absolute per-bin change across same-operator cloud/native refinement and no-CIC-compensation controls is added to envelope. Finite discrepancy, not a rigorous error bound on every scenario.

search.interpretation: Every listed box is robust only against this finite retained family. Envelopes can use different members per box; no common globally adequate model is asserted. Multiple scales/regions/gates are correlated and exploratory.

noise: 20 real translated apertures, spatially overlapping and not independent; refit training data+blank_train and propagate amplitude change. Local empirical noise sensitivity, not calibrated null sampling.
emission_selection_scope: Supplementary descriptive subset fixed by nominal model prediction>one measured blank scatter per bin, not observed data threshold; selection still comes from already fitted source.
